name: html-inline-svg-css-definite-size-no-intrinsic-size
description: An inline SVG whose CSS sets a definite width keeps CSS as the sole owner of its box; the materialized SVG asset gets no viewBox-derived width/height.

source_reference.notes: Companion guard for html-inline-svg-css-limit-only-intrinsic-size: intrinsic dimensions are only carried when CSS provides limits without a definite width or height.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
